response.sql:
WITH filtered_data AS (
  SELECT 
    o.weathprofile,
    t.bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  WHERE t.detecttempk > 152.1
),
profile_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    weathprofile,
    AVG(bandusagepct) as profile_avg,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM filtered_data
  GROUP BY weathprofile
),
mean_of_averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(profile_avg) as overall_mean
  FROM profile_stats
)
SELECT 
  p.weathprofile,
  p.profile_avg,
  p.telescope_count,
  p.profile_avg - m.overall_mean as deviation
FROM profile_stats p
CROSS JOIN mean_of_averages m
WHERE m.overall_mean IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.weathprofile;

assumptions.assumption: "The number of telescopes" counts all telescopes in each weather profile, including those with missing bandwidth values. Only the average bandwidth calculation explicitly ignores NULL values (per the request); the count is total telescopes.

alternatives.interpretation: If "the number of telescopes" should only count telescopes with non-NULL bandwidth values (treating the missing-values filter as applying to both the average and the count), change COUNT(*) to COUNT(bandusagepct) in the profile_stats CTE.
